Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Holder Crossvault Capital Management Has Upped Its Stake; Menora Mivtachim Holdings LTD Increases Stake in Tower Semiconductor LTD (TSEM)
June 5, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd increased its stake in Tower Semiconductor Ltd (TSEM) by 6.06% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd bought 55,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.24% with the market. The institutional investor held 963,313 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $25.92M, up from 908,313 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd who had been investing in Tower Semiconductor Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.58B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.76% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $26.09. About 274,758 shares traded. Tower Semiconductor Ltd. (NASDAQ:TSEM) has declined 0.70% since June 5, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.27% the S&P500.
Crossvault Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd. (SLB) by 40.01% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Crossvault Capital Management Llc bought 12,740 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 44,585 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.89M, up from 31,845 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Crossvault Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $94.85 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $68.48. About 4.09 million shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 1.14% since June 5, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.71% the S&P500.
